title: chore: remove dead grafana alerting and observability leftovers
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed Grafana alerting that was not reaching Discord: the webhook returned 404, and Grafana 11.4 ignored the custom alert body. The community monitor already covers official-model outages. Set crons to an empty list and removed the scheduled health ping, allowing the Grafana container to sleep after 10 idle minutes; the next open cold-starts it from a fresh disk. Moved ClickHouse plugin installation from startup to image build. Made provisioned dashboards read-only in the UI. Removed the DigitalOcean production compose file, stale documentation and agent rules, the unused deploy:production script, and the TypeScript dev dependency. Grafana no longer receives DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL or TINYBIRD_LEGACY_READ_TOKEN; the secret mapping remains unchanged.
